products.name: Lokalise AI
products.note: Localization AI; continuous translation; developer workflow; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Lokalise is a continuous localization and translation management platform founded in 2016 and headquartered in Newark, Delaware. The company describes itself as integrating into development workflows so that teams can ship localized products faster, bringing localization into a single system that connects workflows and standardizes execution across markets.

The company's core AI product, Lokalise AI, sits within the localization and translation category and is noted as UK-hosted. The platform applies approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary to keep translations consistent across languages, and uses Custom AI Profiles, surrounding context, and metadata to preserve meaning. Lokalise AI also evaluates translation quality automatically, routing only low-confidence results for human review, and dynamically selects from multiple large language models based on language, content, and context without requiring repeated configuration. The platform applies role-based access control across both its web interface and API.

The held facts show ten Delaware legal exposure entries associated with the company, though no specific litigation cases are on record. Lokalise has a tracked presence on theworldofai.org, verified as of August 2026.
